jobs.title: Schnupperlehre Polymechaniker/in EFZ

titleByLocale.it: Schnupperlehre Polymechaniker/in CFC
titleByLocale.en: Polymechanics/EFZ

jobs.description:
An der Universität Bern werden jährlich drei Lehrstellen als Polymechaniker/in EFZ neu besetzt. Die Ausbildung wird an den drei Instituten Physikalisches Institut, ARTORG und DCBP angeboten.

Aufgaben:
Während der ersten Lehrhälfte wird in der Grundausbildung ein breites Fundament an Wissen und Können gelegt. In der Werkstatt werden Arbeitstechniken wie manuelle und maschinelle Fertigungstechnik, Montagetechnik, Fügetechnik, Wartung und fachspezifische Arbeitssicherheit vermittelt. In der erweiterten Grundausbildung werden die verschiedenen Arbeitstechniken durch exemplarisches Lernen an und Projekten vertieft. Die Schwerpunktausbildung erfolgt in der zweiten Lehrhälfte. In dieser Ausbildungsphase wird die Bedienung und Programmierung von CNC-gesteuerten Werkzeugmaschinen vermittelt. In einem Konstruktionspraktikum erfolgt der Einblick in die Konstruktions- und CAD-Technik.

Anforderungen:
Gesucht werden motivierte, gute Sekundar- oder sehr gute Realschüler/innen mit sehr guten Kenntnissen in Mathematik und Physik. Zudem sind Interesse an technischen Zusammenhängen, handwerkliches Geschick, gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen sowie eine exakte und selbständige Arbeitsweise gefragt. Ausdauer, Durchhaltevermögen, Geduld und Zuverlässigkeit sindebenso wichtige Eigenschaften. Der Beruf bedingt, dass du frei von Allergien auf Metalle, Öle und Fette bist.

Wir bieten:
Die Schnupperlehre bietet dir die Möglichkeit, den Beruf des Polymechanikers sowie die Institute ARTORG, DCBP und das Physikalische Institut näher kennenzulernen und erste Erfahrungen in der Arbeitswelt zu sammeln. Die Schnupperlehre wird von Januar bis Juni, jeweils von Montag bis Mittwoch, angeboten.

descriptionByLocale.it:
I tre istituti dell'Istituto di Fisica, ARTORG e DCBP offrono la formazione. Compiti: Durante la prima metà del corso, si pone un'ampia base sulle conoscenze e sulle competenze. In officina vengono insegnate tecniche di lavoro come la tecnologia di fabbricazione manuale e meccanica, la tecnologia di assemblaggio, l'unione di tecnologia, la manutenzione e la sicurezza specialistica. Nella formazione di base estesa, le varie tecniche di lavoro sono approfondite da ex-studi e progetti. La formazione principale è nella seconda metà dell'apprendistato. Durante questa fase di formazione, il funzionamento e la programmazione di macchine utensili controllati CNC è insegnato. In uno stage di progettazione, la comprensione del design e la tecnologia CAD è fornita.
• Requisiti: Motivated, buon Sekundar o molto buoni studenti reali con una buona conoscenza della matematica e della fisica sono ricercati. Inoltre, l'interesse per i rapporti tecnici, l'artigianalità, la buona immaginazione spaziale e un metodo di lavoro preciso e indipendente sono necessarie. Perseveranza, perseveranza, pazienza e affidabilità sono anche caratteristiche importanti. La professione richiede che tu sia privo di allergie ai metalli, oli e grassi.
• Offriamo: L'apprendistato ti offre l'opportunità di conoscere la professione di polimeccanica così come gli istituti ARTORG, DCBP e il physikalische Institut e di acquisire le prime esperienze nel mondo del lavoro. L'apprendistato è offerto da gennaio a giugno, da lunedì a mercoledì.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The three institutes of the Institute of Physics, ARTORG and DCBP offer the training. Tasks: During the first half of the course, a broad foundation is laid on knowledge and skills. In the workshop, work techniques such as manual and machine manufacturing technology, assembly technology, joining technology, maintenance and specialist safety are taught. In the extended basic training, the various working techniques are deepened by ex-studies and projects. The main training is in the second half of the apprenticeship. During this training phase, the operation and programming of CNC-controlled machine tools is taught. In a design internship, the insight into the design and CAD technology is provided.
• Requirements: Motivated, good Sekundar or very good real students with very good knowledge of mathematics and physics are sought. In addition, interest in technical relationships, craftsmanship, good spatial imagination and an exact and independent working method are required. Perseverance, perseverance, patience and reliability are also important characteristics. The profession requires that you are free of allergies to metals, oils and fats.
• We offer: The apprenticeship offers you the opportunity to get to know the profession of polymechanics as well as the institutes ARTORG, DCBP and the Physikalische Institut and to gain first experiences in the world of work. The apprenticeship is offered from January to June, from Monday to Wednesday.

jobs.title: PostDoc in exoplanet atmospheres at the University of Bern

titleByLocale.it: PostDoc in atmosfere di exoplanet presso l'Università di Berna
titleByLocale.en: PostDoc in exoplanet atmospheres at the University of Bern
titleByLocale.de: PostDoc in exoplanet atmospheres at the University of Bern
titleByLocale.fr: PostDoc dans les atmosphères exoplanètes à l'Université de Berne

jobs.description:
UniBE is prestigious.
With us, you benefit from the excellent reputation of a long-standing institution all around the world. Aufgaben: The ideal candidate would have expertise in applying Bayesian statistical methods to astronomical datasets, experience modelling exoplanetary transits, deep knowledge of atmospheric physics (e.g. chemistry, radiative transfer, etc), and a proven track record as an independent researcher. Specifically, expertise extracting spectra from JWST timeseries data and the retrieval of abundances will be most useful. Additional theoretical expertise in connecting sub-Neptune interiors & atmospheres would also be beneficial. The fellow would have the opportunity to play a key role in the IN/AT-SYNC JWST large programme targeting the atmospheres of sub-Neptunes in resonant systems (Co-PI Osborn). The PostDoc is additionally expected to help obtain further JWST transmission spectra of sub-Neptunes. The PostDoc will be expected to contribute to the project goals but will also have a large fraction of protected time for independent research. The position also comes with generous travel support covering multiple international conferences or research visits per year. PostDocs are also expected to assist with teaching at the University of Bern, and have the possibility to directly supervise Masters projects and to provide mentoring to existing PhD students. Anforderungen: Bern's Physics institute hosts multiple groups studying both exoplanet (atmospheres, interiors, formation, direct imaging) and solar system (planetary imaging, remote sensing, etc) astronomy. This makes for a welcoming and egalitarian research environment. The university of Bern is a top-200 global university in a welcoming international city which is frequently found in the top-10 most liveable cities worldwide. PostDoc salaries are internationally competitive. The position is funded for 2 years with a possible 1 year extension. We welcome candidates from diverse and minority groups & non-linear career paths. The annual salary is determined by a matrix provided by the Swiss National Fund. Child allowance and maternity/paternity leave are offered. Wir bieten: International reputation

Die UniBE ist vielseitig.
Bei uns erwartet Sie eine grosse Themenvielfalt und viel Gestaltungsfreiraum. • Hai buone capacità comunicative e tieni la testa fresca anche in situazioni stressanti
• Sei motivato a lavorare in modo indipendente e responsabile e sei interessato ad imparare nuove cose

• Sei interessato al lavoro scientifico Il programma per il corso dell'anno durerà dai 25 ai 26 mesi. I partecipanti completano diverse settimane di rotazioni nei reparti di medicina interna (compresa nefrologia), chirurgia, medicina di emergenza e intensiva, anestesologia, radiologia e neurologia e sono coinvolti nei servizi di emergenza del fine settimana. Nel secondo anno i partecipanti lavorano nei servizi di emergenza (notte, fine settimana, vacanze). Inoltre, i partecipanti svolgono un progetto di ricerca (ad esempio, dissertazione sull'acquisizione del titolo del Dr. med. veter.) o completano ulteriori rotazioni cliniche (ad esempio, un importante soggetto di chirurgia). Dopo il completamento del programma, i partecipanti soddisfano i requisiti per ottenere il titolo di specialista FVH piccoli animali di GST. Inoltre, i partecipanti possono essere ammessi a una residenza in conformità con le linee guida dei corrispondenti collegi. Inoltre, offriamo un sistema di registrazione del tempo, dove gli straordinari sono completamente compensati. Il Kleintierklinik Berna, parte della Facoltà Vetsuisse dell'Università di Berna, offre un ambiente di lavoro moderno e simpatico, che è orientato sia all'eccellenza clinica e lo sviluppo accademico. L'attenzione è rivolta alla cura completa dei piccoli animali, in cui si svolgono trattamenti sia ambulatoriali che ricoverati secondo le ultime scoperte di medicina animale. I nostri stagisti sono fortemente coinvolti nel lavoro clinico, che è una parte importante della loro attività. Questo lavoro comprende non solo l'assistenza diretta ai pazienti, ma anche la cooperazione con residenti, altri interni e studenti, che contribuisce allo sviluppo professionale continuo.

• Self-responsible management of patients in the areas of emergency/intensive medicine, internal medicine, surgery, neurology and anaesthesia under supervision of experienced specialists:inside
• Self-employed implementation and interpretation of diagnostic imaging procedures (X-rays)
• Participation in clinical training of students of all ages
• Regular, active participation in various internal training courses of the special departments (Book Club, Journal Club, seminars)
• Night, weekend and holiday services
• Preparation of a scientific project with the objective of Dr. Specialty or med. vet. in a department. Requirements:
• Completed studies of veterinary medicine with diploma (Switzerland) or a diploma recognized by the BAG; ideally you are a newly graduated veterinarian. Veterinarians
• You enjoy working in a large international team
• You have good communication skills and keep a cool head even in stressful situations
• You are motivated to work independently and responsibly and are interested in learning new things
• You have very good knowledge of the German and French language (written and oral)
• You are interested in scientific work The program for the course of the year will last 25 to 26 months. The participants complete several weeks of rotations in the departments of internal medicine (including nephrology), surgery, emergency and intensive medicine, anesthesiology, radiology and neurology and are involved in the weekend emergency services. In the second year, the participants work in emergency services (nights, weekends, holidays). In addition, the participants either carry out a research project (e.g. dissertation on the acquisition of the Dr. med. vet. title) or complete further clinical rotations (e.g. a major subject of surgery). After successful completion of the program, the participants meet the requirements for obtaining the specialist title FVH small animals of GST. Also, the participants can be admitted to a Residency in accordance with the guidelines of the corresponding colleges. In addition, we offer a time recording system, where overtime is fully compensated. The Kleintierklinik Bern, part of the Vetsuisse Faculty of the University of Bern, offers a modern and sympathetic working environment, which is geared to both clinical excellence and academic development. The focus is on the comprehensive care of small animals, in which both outpatient and inpatient treatments are carried out according to the latest animal medicine findings. Our interns are strongly involved in clinical work, which is a major part of their activity. This work includes not only direct patient care, but also cooperation with residents, other internals and students, which contributes to the continuous professional development. We offer: Inspiring working environment

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
Candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field of sustainable development and demonstrate international recognition in research for sustainability transformations. The successful candidate brings a strong record in the management of complex inter- and transdisciplinary research organizations and has proven skills in organizational and strategic leadership. The position requires the ability to build on the Centre's profile in sustainability sciences and practice and to maintain and further develop its standing as an academic partner for policy, society, private sector and administration.

Anforderungen:
Applicants are expected to have extensive experience in shaping transnational research partnerships, particularly with countries in the Global South, and a proven track record in securing third-party funding for both academic research and research-based implementation. A cooperative leadership style, intercultural competence, experience in knowledge transfer, outstanding management and communication skills, and the ability to inspire and lead interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary teams complete this demanding profile. We expect the future position holder to be familiar with Swiss and international science and development policy, and to be recognized as a trusted partner for national and international implementation agencies. Command of at least one of Switzerland's national languages and familiarity with its academic system are an advantage. Fluency in English is required. The professorship will be hosted at CDE and affiliated with one of the departments or institutes of the Faculty of Science.

For further information on this position, please contact Prof. Dr. Ben Jann, President of the CDE Board (ben.jann@unibe.ch).

Inspiring work environment

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
Together with the platform leads and members, the recruited person will actively engage in platform coordination and scientific animation activities, provide expertise and feedback to graduate students and other Early Career Researchers. Scientific animation may include crash-courses on topics relevant to the platform and the recruited person. With a baseline affiliation in statistics, the recruited person will be encouraged to regularly visit and possibly be hosted (part time) in other OCCR groups depending on collaborations.
Employment conditions and remuneration are in accordance with the standards of the University of Bern, Switzerland.

The successful candidate holds a PhD in statistics / ML / applied mathematics and has a strong interest in climate and weather applications, or he/she holds a PhD in climate or atmospheric science, meteorology or similar with an excellent background in statistics and ML. She/he has excellent programming and data handling skills, and a keen interest in interdisciplinary research. The candidate is proficient in English, both written and spoken.

With us, you benefit from the central location and easy-to-reach sites. Aufgaben: We are seeking a board-certified veterinary neurologist holding an ECVN or ACVIM Diploma in Neurology. Board-eligible candidates with a clear pathway to certification will also be considered. The successful candidate is expected to bring a strong commitment to both clinical excellence and research and academic engagement. The role encompasses advanced neurological case management alongside active participation in established and developing research projects. For candidates with academic ambitions, the University offers structured pathways toward habilitation-equivalent qualifications, tailored to individual career goals. Teaching is an integral component of this position, spanning undergraduate veterinary education as well as postgraduate and residency training programmes. Enthusiasm for mentoring the next generation of neurologists is essential. The Division The Division of Neurology is a dynamic referral service managing approximately 1,000 neurological cases per year, supported by state-of-the-art diagnostics, neurosurgery, and a full range of diagnostic and therapeutic facilities. It is embedded in the busy multi-disciplinary environment of the Small Animal Teaching Hospital with regular exposure to large animals. The Vetsuisse Faculty Bern offers a very stimulating neuroscience research environment with strong multidisciplinary collaborative links to neuropathology and neuroimaging groups. Anforderungen: The Candidate must demonstrate proficiency in at least one of Switzerland's national languages (German, French, or Italian), as required for professional practice in Switzerland. Fluency in English is equally essential, as it serves as the primary working language within the Divisions. Conditions The position is available from 1st October 2026, although a later start date can be arranged if required. The successful candidate will benefit from five weeks of annual leave and competitive remuneration commensurate with experience. Bern and the surrounding region offer an exceptional quality of life, with all its breathtaking landscapes, excellent health care and multiple possibilities for sports and other recreational activities. Wir bieten: Healthy corporate culture and good working atmosphere

jobs.description:
UniBE is interconnected.
With us, you're part of an international community and benefit from interdisciplinary collaboration. Aufgaben: In this role, you will help drive the next phase of RegCheck's development, leading empirical work on how RegCheck performs in practical settings and shaping where the tool goes next. Depending on your interests and strengths, your responsibilities could include: • Leading studies evaluating RegCheck's usability and real-world performance, including field trials with journals and editorial teams. • Developing and testing extensions to RegCheck. • Contributing to RegCheck's open-source codebase and reproducible analysis pipelines. • Preparing publications and presenting at international conferences. • Collaborating on projects connected to RegCheck and optionally co-supervising student projects connected to RegCheck. You will build expertise in large language models and metascience as part of our international team, with scope to pursue other collaborative research projects. Teaching opportunities are available in English and/or German. descriptionByLocale.de:
UniBE ist miteinander verbunden.
Mit uns sind Sie Teil einer internationalen Gemeinschaft und profitieren von interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit. Aufgaben: In dieser Rolle werden Sie dazu beitragen, die nächste Phase der RegCheck-Entwicklung voranzutreiben, indem Sie empirische Arbeiten darüber leiten, wie RegCheck in praktischen Einstellungen arbeitet und gestaltet, wohin das Tool als nächstes geht. Abhängig von Ihren Interessen und Stärken können Ihre Aufgaben Folgendes umfassen: • Führende Studien, die die Benutzerfreundlichkeit und die reale Leistung von RegCheck bewerten, einschließlich Feldversuchen mit Zeitschriften und Redaktionsteams. • Entwicklung und Testen von Erweiterungen für RegCheck. • Beitrag zu RegChecks Open-Source-Codebasis und reproduzierbaren Analysepipelines. • Vorbereitung von Publikationen und Präsentation auf internationalen Konferenzen. • Zusammenarbeit in Projekten, die mit RegCheck verbunden sind, und optional Co-Betreuung von Studentenprojekten, die mit RegCheck verbunden sind. Sie werden Expertise in großen Sprachmodellen und Metawissenschaften als Teil unseres internationalen Teams aufbauen, mit Möglichkeiten, andere Verbundforschungsprojekte zu verfolgen. Unterrichtsmöglichkeiten sind in Englisch und/oder Deutsch verfügbar. Diese Position ist entweder als Postdoc- oder PhD-Stelle verfügbar (die Postdoc-Stelle wird ein 18-Monats-Vertrag sein; die PhD-Stelle ist ein anfänglicher 18-Monats-Vertrag mit Verlängerungen von insgesamt bis zu 4 Jahren für die gesamte PhD). Ihr Profil: • Ausbildung: Ein Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Metawissenschaften, Psychologie, Mensch-Computer-Interaktion, Medizin, Epidemiologie, Wirtschaft, Forschungsmethoden, Statistik oder einem verwandten Bereich. • Technische Fähigkeiten: Arbeitskenntnisse von R für Datenmanagement und statistische Analyse; ein Verständnis dafür, wie LLMs arbeiten und Erfahrungen mit ihnen programmatisch (z. B. über eine API) oder eine starke Lernbereitschaft. • Forschungsinteressen: Ein tiefes Interesse an Meta-Wissenschaft, Open-Science-Praktiken und Vertrauenswürdigkeitsbewertung / Qualitätsmanagement der Forschung. • Vertrautheit mit den Prinzipien offener und reproduzierbarer Forschung. • Sprache: Starkes geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch. • Verfügbarkeit: Während diese Position persönlich ist, gibt es eine große Flexibilität in den Arbeitszeiten. Der ideale Starttermin ist der 1. November. Anforderungen: • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt: Das PhD-Gehalt beträgt rund CHF 50.000 brutto inklusive 13. Monat (~ EUR 54.000 /~ USD 63.000). Anmerkung: Doktoranden in der Schweiz haben den doppelten Status sowohl als Angestellte als auch als eingeschriebene Studierende; die jährlichen Studiengebühren betragen ca. CHF 200. Das Postdoc-Gehalt für einen frühen Postdoc beträgt ca. CHF 91.000 brutto inklusive 13. Monat (~ 98.000 EUR /~111.000 USD). • Gedeihendes intellektuelles Umfeld: Bern entwickelt sich schnell zu einem Zentrum für Metawissenschaften, wobei aktive Metawissenschaftler in den Bereichen Psychologie, Medizin, Epidemiologie und Wirtschaft arbeiten. Sie würden einer Gemeinschaft von Metawissenschaftlern innerhalb und außerhalb der Universität beitreten, mit starken internationalen Verbindungen und einem Team, das innovative Open-Source-Forschungswerkzeuge produziert und sich wirklich um die Verbesserung der Wissenschaft kümmert. • Karriereentwicklung: Zugang zu Ausbildung in Forschungsmethoden, wissenschaftlichem Schreiben und Universitätspädagogik. Lern- und Zusammenarbeitsmöglichkeiten mit etwa 10 anderen Forschern, Postdocs und Dozenten in unserer Forschungsgruppe. Unterrichtserfahrungen stehen zur Verfügung (auf Englisch oder Deutsch). Wir bieten auch Unterstützung für Stipendien- / Förderanträge oder die Entwicklung einer unabhängigen Forschungslinie an. • Lebensqualität: Bern ist eine der sichersten Städte der Welt. Es ist begehbar und UNESCO-gelistet mit ausgezeichneten öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, Erholung im Freien und einer lebendigen internationalen akademischen Gemeinschaft. Die Schweiz zählt konsequent zu den Top-Ländern der Welt für Lebensqualität. Unsere Abteilung hat Erfahrung in der Unterstützung internationaler Mitarbeiter und verfügt über ein optimiertes Verfahren für Aufenthaltsgenehmigungsanträge (B-Permit). Vielfalt & Inklusion: Wir engagieren uns für den Aufbau einer vielfältigen Forschungsgruppe und begrüßen insbesondere Bewerbungen von Frauen und Menschen, die in den Metawissenschaften und den Computational Social Sciences unterrepräsentiert sind. Gerne diskutieren wir über flexible Arbeits- und Unterstützungsbedürfnisse. Wir bieten: Internationale Reputation

UniBE est interconnecté.

Aufgaben: Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à conduire la prochaine phase du développement de RegCheck, menant un travail empirique sur la façon dont RegCheck fonctionne dans des cadres pratiques et façonnant où l'outil va ensuite. Selon vos intérêts et vos forces, vos responsabilités pourraient comprendre : • Principales études évaluant la convivialité et la performance réelle de RegCheck, y compris des essais sur le terrain avec des revues et des équipes éditoriales. • Développer et tester des extensions à RegCheck. • Contribution à la base de codes open-source de RegCheck et aux pipelines d'analyse reproductibles. • Préparation de publications et présentation lors de conférences internationales. • Collaborer sur des projets liés à RegCheck et éventuellement co-superviser des projets étudiants liés à RegCheck. Vous développerez une expertise dans les grands modèles linguistiques et les métasciences dans le cadre de notre équipe internationale, avec la possibilité de poursuivre d'autres projets de recherche en collaboration. Des possibilités d'enseignement sont disponibles en anglais et/ou en allemand. Ce poste est disponible en tant que poste postdoctoral ou doctorat (le poste postdoctoral sera un contrat de 18 mois; le poste postdoctoral est un contrat initial de 18 mois, avec des prolongations de 4 ans au total pour l'ensemble du doctorat). Votre profil: • Éducation : Maîtrise ou doctorat en Métascience, psychologie, interaction humain-informatique, médecine, épidémiologie, économie, méthodes de recherche, statistiques ou un domaine connexe. • Compétences techniques: Connaissances pratiques de la R pour la gestion des données et l'analyse statistique; compréhension du fonctionnement et de l'expérience des LLM en les utilisant programmatiquement (par exemple via une API) ou une forte volonté d'apprendre. • Intérêts de recherche : Intérêt profond pour les méta-sciences, les pratiques scientifiques ouvertes et l'évaluation de la fiabilité/gestion de la qualité de la recherche. • Connaissance des principes de la recherche ouverte et reproductible. • Langue: L'anglais fort écrit et parlé. • Disponibilité: Bien que ce poste soit en personne, il y a une grande flexibilité dans les heures de travail. La date de début idéale est le 1er novembre. - C'est pas vrai. • Salaire compétitif: Le salaire du doctorat est d'environ CHF 50 000 brut dont 13e mois (~54 000 EUR /~63 000 USD). Note: Les doctorants en Suisse ont le double statut d'employés et d'étudiants inscrits; les frais annuels d'inscription sont d'environ CHF 200. Le salaire postdoc pour un postdoc précoce est d'environ CHF 91.000 brut y compris 13e mois (~98.000 EUR /~ 111.000 USD). • Environnement intellectuel vivifiant : Bern devient rapidement une plaque tournante de la métascience, avec des métascientifiques actifs travaillant à travers la psychologie, la médecine, l'épidémiologie et l'économie. Vous rejoindrez une communauté de métascientifiques à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'université, avec de solides liens internationaux, et une équipe qui produit des outils de recherche à la fine pointe de la technologie et qui se soucie vraiment de l'amélioration de la science. • Évolution de la carrière : Accès à la formation en méthodes de recherche, écriture scientifique et pédagogie universitaire. Possibilités d'apprentissage et de collaboration avec environ 10 autres chercheurs, postdoctorants et professeurs de notre groupe de recherche. Des possibilités d'expérience pédagogique sont disponibles (en anglais ou en allemand). Nous offrons également un soutien pour les demandes de bourses ou de subventions, ou le développement d'une ligne de recherche indépendante. • Qualité de vie: Bern est l'une des villes les plus sûres au monde. Il est accessible à pied et classé par l'UNESCO avec d'excellents transports en commun, des loisirs en plein air et une communauté universitaire internationale animée. La Suisse se classe toujours parmi les premiers pays au monde pour la qualité de vie. Notre ministère a de l'expérience à l'appui des embauches internationales et a un processus simplifié en place pour les demandes de permis de séjour (permis B). Diversité et inclusion : Nous sommes déterminés à créer un groupe de recherche diversifié et nous souhaitons la bienvenue aux applications des femmes et des personnes sous-représentées dans les métasciences et les sciences sociales informatiques. Nous sommes heureux de discuter des besoins de travail et de soutien flexibles. - Oui. La réputation internationale

descriptionByLocale.en:
UniBE is interconnected.
With us, you're part of an international community and benefit from interdisciplinary collaboration. Aufgaben: In this role, you will help drive the next phase of RegCheck's development, leading empirical work on how RegCheck performs in practical settings and shaping where the tool goes next. Depending on your interests and strengths, your responsibilities could include: • Leading studies evaluating RegCheck's usability and real-world performance, including field trials with journals and editorial teams. • Developing and testing extensions to RegCheck. • Contributing to RegCheck's open-source codebase and reproducible analysis pipelines. • Preparing publications and presenting at international conferences. • Collaborating on projects connected to RegCheck and optionally co-supervising student projects connected to RegCheck. You will build expertise in large language models and metascience as part of our international team, with scope to pursue other collaborative research projects. Teaching opportunities are available in English and/or German. This position is available as either a Postdoc or PhD position (the postdoc position will be an 18 months contract; the PhD position is an initial 18-month contract, with extensions of up to 4 years in total for the entire PhD). Your profile: • Education: A Master's degree or PhD in Metascience, Psychology, Human-Computer-Interaction, Medicine, Epidemiology, Economics, Research Methods, Statistics, or a related field. • Technical skills: Working knowledge of R for data management and statistical analysis; an understanding of how LLMs work and experience using them programmatically (e.g. via an API) or a strong willingness to learn. • Research interests: A deep interest in meta-science, open science practices, and trustworthiness assessment/quality management of research. • Familiarity with the principles of open and reproducible research. • Language: Strong written and spoken English. • Availability: While this position is in-person, there is great flexibility in working hours. The ideal start date is November 1st. Anforderungen: • Competitive salary: PhD salary is approximately CHF 50,000 Gross including 13th month (~EUR 54,000 /~USD 63,000). Note: PhD students in Switzerland hold dual status as both employees and enrolled students; annual student fees are approximately CHF 200. Postdoc salary for an early Postdoc is approximately CHF 91,000 Gross including 13th month (~EUR 98,000 /~USD 111,000). • Thriving intellectual environment: Bern is fast becoming a hub for metascience, with active metascientists working across psychology, medicine, epidemiology, and economics. You would join a community of metascientists within and beyond the university, with strong international connections, and a team that produces cutting edge open-source research tools, and genuinely cares about improving science. • Career development: Access to training in research methods, scientific writing, and university pedagogy. Learning and collaboration opportunities with approximately 10 other researchers, postdocs, and faculty in our research group. Teaching experience opportunities are available (in English or German). We also offer support for fellowship/grant applications, or developing an independent research line. • Quality of life: Bern is one of the world's safest cities. It is walkable and UNESCO-listed with excellent public transport links, outdoor recreation, and a lively international academic community. Switzerland consistently ranks among the top countries in the world for quality of life. Our department has experience supporting international hires and has a streamlined process in place for residence permit applications (B-permit). Diversity & inclusion: We are committed to building a diverse research group and especially welcome applications from women and people underrepresented in metascience and the computational social sciences. We are happy to discuss flexible working and support needs. Wir bieten: International reputation

Abhängig von Ihren Interessen und Stärken können Ihre Aufgaben Folgendes umfassen: • Führende Studien, die die Benutzerfreundlichkeit und die reale Leistung von RegCheck bewerten, einschließlich Feldversuchen mit Zeitschriften und Redaktionsteams. • Entwicklung und Testen von Erweiterungen für RegCheck. • Beitrag zu RegChecks Open-Source-Codebasis und reproduzierbaren Analysepipelines. • Vorbereitung von Publikationen und Präsentation auf internationalen Konferenzen. • Zusammenarbeit in Projekten, die mit RegCheck verbunden sind, und optional Co-Betreuung von Studentenprojekten, die mit RegCheck verbunden sind. Sie werden Expertise in großen Sprachmodellen und Metawissenschaften als Teil unseres internationalen Teams aufbauen, mit Möglichkeiten, andere Verbundforschungsprojekte zu verfolgen. Unterrichtsmöglichkeiten sind in Englisch und/oder Deutsch verfügbar. Diese Position ist entweder als Postdoc- oder PhD-Stelle verfügbar (die Postdoc-Stelle wird ein 18-Monats-Vertrag sein; die PhD-Stelle ist ein anfänglicher 18-Monats-Vertrag mit Verlängerungen von insgesamt bis zu 4 Jahren für die gesamte PhD). Ihr Profil: • Ausbildung: Ein Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Metawissenschaften, Psychologie, Mensch-Computer-Interaktion, Medizin, Epidemiologie, Wirtschaft, Forschungsmethoden, Statistik oder einem verwandten Bereich. • Technische Fähigkeiten: Arbeitskenntnisse von R für Datenmanagement und statistische Analyse; ein Verständnis dafür, wie LLMs arbeiten und Erfahrungen mit ihnen programmatisch (z. B. über eine API) oder eine starke Lernbereitschaft. • Forschungsinteressen: Ein tiefes Interesse an Meta-Wissenschaft, Open-Science-Praktiken und Vertrauenswürdigkeitsbewertung / Qualitätsmanagement der Forschung. • Vertrautheit mit den Prinzipien offener und reproduzierbarer Forschung. • Sprache: Starkes geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch. • Verfügbarkeit: Während diese Position persönlich ist, gibt es eine große Flexibilität in den Arbeitszeiten. Der ideale Starttermin ist der 1. November. Anforderungen: • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt: Das PhD-Gehalt beträgt rund CHF 50.000 brutto inklusive 13. Monat (~ EUR 54.000 /~ USD 63.000). Anmerkung: Doktoranden in der Schweiz haben den doppelten Status sowohl als Angestellte als auch als eingeschriebene Studierende; die jährlichen Studiengebühren betragen ca. CHF 200. Monat (~ 98.000 EUR /~111.000 USD). • Gedeihendes intellektuelles Umfeld: Bern entwickelt sich schnell zu einem Zentrum für Metawissenschaften, wobei aktive Metawissenschaftler in den Bereichen Psychologie, Medizin, Epidemiologie und Wirtschaft arbeiten. Sie würden einer Gemeinschaft von Metawissenschaftlern innerhalb und außerhalb der Universität beitreten, mit starken internationalen Verbindungen und einem Team, das innovative Open-Source-Forschungswerkzeuge produziert und sich wirklich um die Verbesserung der Wissenschaft kümmert. • Karriereentwicklung: Zugang zu Ausbildung in Forschungsmethoden, wissenschaftlichem Schreiben und Universitätspädagogik. Lern- und Zusammenarbeitsmöglichkeiten mit etwa 10 anderen Forschern, Postdocs und Dozenten in unserer Forschungsgruppe. Unterrichtserfahrungen stehen zur Verfügung (auf Englisch oder Deutsch). Wir bieten auch Unterstützung für Stipendien- / Förderanträge oder die Entwicklung einer unabhängigen Forschungslinie an. • Lebensqualität: Bern ist eine der sichersten Städte der Welt. Es ist begehbar und UNESCO-gelistet mit ausgezeichneten öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, Erholung im Freien und einer lebendigen internationalen akademischen Gemeinschaft. Die Schweiz zählt konsequent zu den Top-Ländern der Welt für Lebensqualität. Unsere Abteilung hat Erfahrung in der Unterstützung internationaler Mitarbeiter und verfügt über ein optimiertes Verfahren für Aufenthaltsgenehmigungsanträge (B-Permit). Vielfalt & Inklusion: Wir engagieren uns für den Aufbau einer vielfältigen Forschungsgruppe und begrüßen insbesondere Bewerbungen von Frauen und Menschen, die in den Metawissenschaften und den Computational Social Sciences unterrepräsentiert sind. jobs.description:
UniBE is quintessentially Bernese.
With us, you can expect a culture of respect and a healthy working environment. Aufgaben: The professorship for “Translational MR-Methodology” is to be filled with an internationally recognized personality with a proven profile in the development of high-field imaging including 7 Tesla. Applicants have a background in physics with a corresponding technology pathway to the clinic or an MD-PhD degree with experience/further training in the relevant field, in each case with a proven focus in MR-sequence development. Expertise in metabolic imaging or another innovative field is an advantage. In addition, existing industry cooperations in this field are preferable. Furthermore, a strong interest in translational research in the field of MR-methodology is essential. Regular publication activity, successful acquisition of competitive external funding and strong international collaborations in academia and with industry partners are required. A high degree of integration and teamwork skills as well as the willingness to cooperate with clinical disciplines is essential. The position also involves integration into existing structures of the Translational Imaging Center Bern TIC. A habilitation or an equivalent academic record is required. Besides teaching skills and an interest in innovative and contemporary teaching and learning concepts, also a strong commitment to the promotion of young researchers, in particular in the supervision of PhD students, is expected. Anforderungen: The University of Bern aims to increase the proportion of women in teaching and research and therefore strongly encourages qualified female scientists to apply. The University of Bern has various programs to help combine work and family life, such as childcare facilities, offers for partners and the possibility of job sharing ( job-sharing requirements ). Job sharing applications are welcome; please submit a concept for collaboration. Wir bieten: International reputation

descriptionByLocale.it:
Aufgaben:
La cattedra di “Mr-Methodology relazionale” è da riempire con una personalità riconosciuta a livello internazionale con un profilo comprovato nello sviluppo di immagini ad alto campo, tra cui 7 Tesla. I candidati hanno un background in fisica con un percorso tecnologico corrispondente alla clinica o un grado MD-PhD con esperienza / più formazione nel campo rilevante, in ogni caso con una comprovata attenzione nello sviluppo di MR-sequence. La competenza in imaging metabolico o un altro campo innovativo è un vantaggio. Inoltre, le cooperazioni industriali esistenti in questo settore sono preferibili.

Inoltre, è essenziale un forte interesse per la ricerca traduttiva nel campo della metodologia MR. Sono necessarie regolari attività di pubblicazione, acquisizione di finanziamenti esterni competitivi e forti collaborazioni internazionali in accademia e con partner del settore.

Un alto grado di integrazione e competenze di lavoro di squadra, nonché la volontà di collaborare con le discipline cliniche è essenziale. La posizione comprende anche l'integrazione nelle strutture esistenti del Centro di Imaging Traduzionale Bern TIC.

È richiesta una abilitazione o un record accademico equivalente. Oltre alle competenze didattiche e all'interesse per i concetti di insegnamento e apprendimento innovativi e contemporanei, è previsto anche un forte impegno per la promozione di giovani ricercatori, in particolare nella supervisione degli studenti di dottorato.

Anforderungen:
L'Università di Berna mira ad aumentare la percentuale di donne nell'insegnamento e nella ricerca e quindi incoraggia fortemente gli scienziati femminili qualificati ad applicare. L'Università di Berna ha vari programmi per aiutare a combinare il lavoro e la vita familiare, come le strutture per l'infanzia, le offerte per i partner e la possibilità di condivisione del lavoro ( requisiti di condivisione del lavoro). Le applicazioni di condivisione del lavoro sono i benvenuti; si prega di presentare un concetto di collaborazione.

Avec nous, vous contribuez à résoudre des tâches sociales importantes. Tâches : • Effectuer l'élevage quotidien chez la souris dans les systèmes isolat et isocage (ABSL1 et ABSL2) • Inspection et évaluation sanitaires régulières des animaux conformément aux directives applicables • Accouplement, reproduction et soins des lignées de souris associées • Fourniture d'isolants avec du matériel stérile et réalisation d'importations et de transferts stériles • Exportation professionnelle et stérile d'animaux d'isolants aux fins de réutilisation scientifique • Documentation et collecte de données dans le domaine de l'élevage, de l'hygiène et du matériel • Soutien aux processus de transfert d'embryons • Échantillonnage selon les lignes directrices applicables (p. ex. échantillons de contrôle microbiologique et analyses génétiques) • Nettoyage, désinfection et préparation pour assurer l'hygiène (cages, bouteilles, connecteurs, équipements, ustensiles de laboratoire et équipements) • Collaboration et échange avec les scientifiques Exigences • Formation complétée en tant qu'ECZ (spécialiste des animaux de laboratoire) ou qualification équivalente • Expérience en soins et soins aux animaux de laboratoire et en élevage pratique • L'expérience de l'élevage axénique ou gnotobiotique est avantageuse, mais pas une condition préalable – une formation soignée est garantie • Méthodes de travail prudentes, structurées et fiables, même pour les travaux de routine • Un haut sens des responsabilités et la jouissance d'un travail précis selon des exigences strictes d'hygiène et de sécurité • eamfähigkeit, auto-initiative et résilience dans les opérations quotidiennes • Préparation au travail dans la zone ABSL-2 • Compétences en anglais oral requises pour l'échange dans un environnement scientifique Nous offrons: Service de fin de semaine planifiable avec rémunération du temps correspondante selon les directives cantonales

jobs.description:
UniBE is ambitious.
With us, you deliver top performance and test your skills against the best. Aufgaben: • Integrate a hydraulics-explicit representation of photosynthesis, transpiration, and their acclimation (P-hydro) into a vegetation demography model (BiomeEP). • Break new ground in using eco-evolutionary optimality principles for simulating tree hydraulic and architectural trait acclimation. • Conduct methods development for model-data integration on the basis of data from ecosystem manipulation experiments, sap flow measurements, and others. • Assess model performance for predicting trait distributions, community compositions, ecosystem fluxes, and forest structures along aridity gradients. • Conduct past-to-future simulations, separating effects of long-term trends in VPD, CO2, tree community shifts, and acclimation. • Build on and integrate into the UP-SCALE project, collaborating closely with project partners, and co-supervising the two PhD students funded through the project. • Reliable and reusable code development, active participation and regular exchange as a group member based in Bern, presentations at national and international conferences, publication of your research emerging from this project in peer-reviewed scientific journals. Anforderungen: The candidate must hold a PhD degree in a relevant discipline and should demonstrate proficient English written and oral skills and excellent analytical and numerical skills. Demonstrated experience with programming (ideally R and Fortran), collaborative code management, and other data science methods are a prerequisite and an open and collaborative mentality for the development of our computational infrastructure is expected. We offer the candidate to be part of a small group with a strong collaborative philosophy and to benefit from a leading academic environment, from an international collaboration within the UP-SCALE project and from the excellent quality of life in Switzerland. You will be hosted at the Institute of Geography and will be part of the Oeschger Centre for Climate Change Research (OCCR). For further information about our group please visit https://geco-group.org/. Wir bieten: International reputation

descriptionByLocale.it:
<b> UniBE è ambizioso. Con noi, si offre le migliori prestazioni e testare le vostre abilità contro il meglio.

Aufgaben:
• Integrare una rappresentazione idraulica-esplicita di fotosintesi, traspirazione e loro acclimazione (P-idro) in un modello di demografia vegetale (BiomeEP).

• Rompere un nuovo terreno nell'utilizzo di principi di ottimizzazione eco-evoluzionari per la simulazione di acclimazione idraulica e architettonica dell'albero.

• Condurre lo sviluppo dei metodi per l'integrazione dei modelli-dati sulla base dei dati da esperimenti di manipolazione dell'ecosistema, misurazioni del flusso di linfa e altri.

• Valuta le prestazioni del modello per predire le distribuzioni del tratto, le composizioni della comunità, i flussi ecosistemici e le strutture forestali lungo i gradienti dell'aridità.

• Condurre simulazioni passato-futuro, separando gli effetti delle tendenze a lungo termine in VPD, CO2, cambiamenti della comunità degli alberi e acclimazione.

• Costruire e integrare nel progetto UP-SCALE, collaborando a stretto contatto con i partner del progetto e co-supervisione dei due studenti di dottorato finanziati attraverso il progetto.

• Sviluppo del codice affidabile e riutilizzabile, partecipazione attiva e scambio regolare come membro del gruppo con sede a Berna, presentazioni a conferenze nazionali e internazionali, pubblicazione della tua ricerca emergente da questo progetto in riviste scientifiche peer-reviewed.

Anforderungen:
Il candidato deve tenere un dottorato in una disciplina rilevante e deve dimostrare competenze scritte e orali in inglese competenti e eccellenti competenze analitiche e numeriche. Esperienza dimostrata con la programmazione (idealmente R e Fortran), la gestione del codice collaborativo e altri metodi di scienza dei dati sono un prerequisito e una mentalità aperta e collaborativa per lo sviluppo della nostra infrastruttura computazionale è prevista.
Offriamo al candidato di essere parte di un piccolo gruppo con una forte filosofia collaborativa e di beneficiare di un ambiente accademico leader, da una collaborazione internazionale all'interno del progetto UP-SCALE e dall'eccellente qualità della vita in Svizzera. Sarete ospitati presso l'Istituto di Geografia e sarà parte del Centro Oeschger per la Ricerca sui Cambiamenti Climatici (OCCR). Per ulteriori informazioni sul nostro gruppo, visitare https://geco-group.org/.

jobs.description:
UniBE is ambitious.
With us, you deliver top performance and test your skills against the best. Aufgaben: • Use the BiomeEP model and a diversity of ecosystem data for understanding responses of growth and mortality to effects of rising VPD and other environmental changes. BiomeEP is a vegetation demography model that resolves ecophysiological processes, biogeochemical cycling, and the water balance of terrestrial ecosystems • Conduct methods development for model-data integration on the basis of data from ecosystem manipulation experiments, continuous dendrometer measurements, sap flow measurements, tree-ring width archives, and forest inventories • Implement recently developed eco-evolutionary optimality-based modelling approaches for simulating acclimation of plant architectural and metabolic traits to a changing hydroclimate, and break new ground in extending this theoretical paradigm to additional processes. • Build on and integrate into the UP-SCALE project, collaborating closely with project partners • Reliable and reusable code development, active participation and regular exchange as a group member based in Bern, presentations at national and international conferences, publication of your PhD research in peer-reviewed scientific journals Anforderungen: The candidate must hold a MSc degree in natural sciences, mathematics, or engineering and should demonstrate proficient English written and oral skills and excellent analytical and numerical skills. Experience with programming and other data science methods are an asset and an open and collaborative mentality for the development of our computational infrastructure is expected. We offer the candidate to be part of a small group with a strong collaborative philosophy and to benefit from a leading academic environment, from an international collaboration within the UP-SCALE project and from the excellent quality of life in Switzerland. This PhD will be placed within the Graduate School of Climate Sciences at Oeschger Centre for Climate Change Research (OCCR) and will draw on supervisory expertise and that bridges physical geography, ecosystem science, vegetation modelling, and climate science. For further information about our group please visit https://geco-group.org/ Wir bieten: International reputation

descriptionByLocale.it:

Aufgaben:
• Utilizzare il modello BiomeEP e una diversità di dati ecosistemici per comprendere le risposte di crescita e mortalità agli effetti dell'aumento della VPD e di altri cambiamenti ambientali. BiomeEP è un modello di demografia vegetale che risolve processi ecofisiologici, ciclismo biogeochimico, e l'equilibrio idrico degli ecosistemi terrestri

• Sviluppo dei metodi di conduzione per l'integrazione dei modelli-dati sulla base di dati provenienti da esperimenti di manipolazione degli ecosistemi, misurazioni del dendrometro continuo, misurazioni del flusso di linfa, archivi di larghezza degli alberi e inventari forestali

• L'implementazione ha recentemente sviluppato approcci di modellazione eco-evoluzionari basati sull'ottimizzazione per la simulazione di acclimazione di tratti architettonici e metabolici vegetali a un cambiamento idroclima, e rompere nuovo terreno nell'estensione di questo paradigma teorico a processi aggiuntivi.

• Costruire e integrare nel progetto UP-SCALE, collaborando a stretto contatto con i partner di progetto

• Sviluppo del codice affidabile e riutilizzabile, partecipazione attiva e scambio regolare come membro del gruppo con sede a Berna, presentazioni a conferenze nazionali e internazionali, pubblicazione della tua ricerca di dottorato in riviste scientifiche peer-reviewed

Anforderungen:
Il candidato deve avere una laurea in scienze naturali, matematica o ingegneria e deve dimostrare competenze scritte e orali in inglese e eccellenti capacità analitiche e numeriche. L'esperienza con la programmazione e altri metodi di data science sono un bene e una mentalità aperta e collaborativa per lo sviluppo della nostra infrastruttura computazionale è prevista.
Offriamo al candidato di essere parte di un piccolo gruppo con una forte filosofia collaborativa e di beneficiare di un ambiente accademico leader, da una collaborazione internazionale all'interno del progetto UP-SCALE e dall'eccellente qualità della vita in Svizzera. Questo PhD sarà posto all'interno della Graduate School of Climate Sciences presso l'Oeschger Centre for Climate Change Research (OCCR) e attirerà le competenze di supervisione e che ponti geografia fisica, ecosistemica, modellazione della vegetazione e scienze del clima. Per ulteriori informazioni sul nostro gruppo visitare https://geco-group.org/

reputazione internazionale

Durchführung von zusätzlichen Laboruntersuchungen Mitarbeit in der Wildtierimmobilisation von Wildkatzen: • Durchführung von Fängen und Anästhesie von freilebende Wildfeliden (ca. 5 Wochen/Jahr) Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Veterinärmedizin • Interesse an der Wildtiergesundheit, insbesondere an Infektionskrankheiten bei Wildfeliden • Klinische Erfahrung, bevorzugt im Bereich Klein- oder Wildtiere • Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englisch- und Französischkenntnisse • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise • Dienstleistungsorientierte und teamfähige Persönlichkeit • Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative Die Position bietet eine hervorragende Grundlage für eine weiterführende Tätigkeit im Bereich der Wildtiergesund-heit oder für eine akademische Karriere. Die Anstellung ist je nach Qualifikation auf 12 oder 18 Monate befristet. Die Vergütung richtet sich nach den Ansätzen des Schweizerischen Nationalfonds. jobs.description:
UniBE is prestigious.
With us, you benefit from the excellent reputation of a long-standing institution all around the world. Aufgaben: You hold (or are close to completing) a Master's degree in physics, astronomy, planetary science, Earth science, computational science, chemistry or a related discipline. You have strong quantitative skills and experience in scientific programming (preferably Python). Experience in planetary science, atmospheric chemistry, geochemistry, microbiology or astrobiology is an advantage but not required. We are looking for a curious, motivated and team-oriented researcher who enjoys working across disciplines. Anforderungen: The position offers an international and interdisciplinary research environment at the forefront of planetary science and astrobiology, with close collaboration with researchers across the NCCR Genesis network. The successful candidate will be employed as a PhD researcher at the University of Bern and work closely with the research groups of Dr Sean Jordan at ETH Zurich and Prof. Audrey Vorburger at the University of Bern, drawing on expertise in computational modelling, atmospheric chemistry, astrobiology and planetary exploration. The project provides opportunities to publish in leading scientific journals, present at international conferences, and collaborate with researchers across a broad range of disciplines. Wir bieten: Collaborative environment and ambitious team

descriptionByLocale.it:

Lei possiede (o è vicino a completare) un master in fisica, astronomia, scienza planetaria, scienza della terra, scienza computazionale, chimica o una disciplina relativa. Hai forti capacità quantitative ed esperienza nella programmazione scientifica (preferibilmente Python). L'esperienza nella scienza planetaria, chimica atmosferica, geochimica, microbiologia o astronomia è un vantaggio ma non richiesto. Siamo alla ricerca di un ricercatore curioso, motivato e orientato al team che ama lavorare attraverso le discipline.

Anforderungen:
La posizione offre un ambiente di ricerca internazionale e interdisciplinare all'avanguardia della scienza planetaria e dell'astrobiologia, con una stretta collaborazione con i ricercatori della rete NCCR Genesis. Il candidato di successo sarà impiegato come ricercatore di dottorato presso l'Università di Berna e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i gruppi di ricerca del dottor Sean Jordan presso l'ETH Zurigo e Prof. Audrey Vorburger all'Università di Berna, attingendo alle competenze nella modellazione computazionale, chimica atmosferica, astronomia e esplorazione planetaria. Il progetto offre l'opportunità di pubblicare nelle principali riviste scientifiche, presenti a conferenze internazionali, e collaborare con i ricercatori in una vasta gamma di discipline.

Wir bieten:
Ambiente collaborativo e team ambizioso
descriptionByLocale.en:
UniBE is prestigious.
With us, you benefit from the excellent reputation of a long-standing institution all around the world. Aufgaben: You hold (or are close to completing) a Master's degree in physics, astronomy, planetary science, Earth science, computational science, chemistry or a related discipline. You have strong quantitative skills and experience in scientific programming (preferably Python). Experience in planetary science, atmospheric chemistry, geochemistry, microbiology or astrobiology is an advantage but not required. We are looking for a curious, motivated and team-oriented researcher who enjoys working across disciplines. Anforderungen: The position offers an international and interdisciplinary research environment at the forefront of planetary science and astrobiology, with close collaboration with researchers across the NCCR Genesis network. The successful candidate will be employed as a PhD researcher at the University of Bern and work closely with the research groups of Dr Sean Jordan at ETH Zurich and Prof. Audrey Vorburger at the University of Bern, drawing on expertise in computational modelling, atmospheric chemistry, astrobiology and planetary exploration. The project provides opportunities to publish in leading scientific journals, present at international conferences, and collaborate with researchers across a broad range of disciplines. Wir bieten: Collaborative environment and ambitious team
descriptionByLocale.de:
UniBE ist prestigeträchtig.
Bei uns profitieren Sie vom exzellenten Ruf einer langjährigen Institution auf der ganzen Welt. Aufgaben: Sie haben (oder sind kurz vor dem Abschluss) einen Master-Abschluss in Physik, Astronomie, Planetenwissenschaften, Geowissenschaften, Computerwissenschaften, Chemie oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Sie haben starke quantitative Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der wissenschaftlichen Programmierung (vorzugsweise Python). Erfahrung in der Planetenwissenschaft, Atmosphärenchemie, Geochemie, Mikrobiologie oder Astrobiologie ist ein Vorteil, aber nicht erforderlich. Wir suchen einen neugierigen, motivierten und teamorientierten Forscher, der gerne disziplinübergreifend arbeitet. Anforderungen: Die Position bietet ein internationales und interdisziplinäres Forschungsumfeld an der Spitze der Planetenwissenschaft und Astrobiologie mit enger Zusammenarbeit mit Forschern des NFS Genesis-Netzwerks. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird als PhD-Forscher an der Universität Bern angestellt und arbeitet eng mit den Arbeitsgruppen von Dr. Sean Jordan an der ETH Zürich und Prof. Dr. Audrey Vorburger an der Universität Bern, die auf Fachwissen in den Bereichen Computermodellierung, Atmosphärenchemie, Astrobiologie und Planetenforschung zurückgreift. Das Projekt bietet die Möglichkeit, in führenden wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften zu veröffentlichen, auf internationalen Konferenzen zu präsentieren und mit Forschern aus einem breiten Spektrum von Disziplinen zusammenzuarbeiten. Wir bieten: Kollaboratives Umfeld und ambitioniertes Team
descriptionByLocale.fr:
UniBE est prestigieux. Avec nous, vous bénéficiez de l'excellente réputation d'une institution de longue date partout dans le monde.

Aufgaben:
Vous possédez (ou êtes sur le point de terminer) une maîtrise en physique, astronomie, sciences planétaires, sciences de la Terre, sciences informatiques, chimie ou une discipline connexe. Vous avez de fortes compétences quantitatives et de l'expérience dans la programmation scientifique (de préférence Python). L'expérience de la science planétaire, de la chimie atmosphérique, de la géochimie, de la microbiologie ou de l'astrobiologie est un avantage, mais pas nécessaire. Nous recherchons un chercheur curieux, motivé et axé sur l'équipe qui aime travailler dans toutes les disciplines.

- C'est pas vrai.
Ce poste offre un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire à l'avant-garde de la science planétaire et de l'astrobiologie, avec une collaboration étroite avec les chercheurs du réseau Genesis du CCNR. Le candidat retenu sera employé comme doctorant à l'Université de Berne et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les groupes de recherche du Dr Sean Jordan à l'ETH Zurich et Prof. Audrey Vorburger à l'Université de Berne, s'appuyant sur l'expertise en modélisation computationnelle, chimie atmosphérique, astrobiologie et exploration planétaire. Le projet offre la possibilité de publier dans des revues scientifiques de premier plan, de participer à des conférences internationales et de collaborer avec des chercheurs dans un large éventail de disciplines.

jobs.description:
UniBE is quintessentially Bernese.
With us, you can expect a culture of respect and a healthy working environment. Aufgaben: The lab is currently developing a digital light processing (DLP)-based bioprinting system combined with acoustic manipulation, where ultrasound fields are used to control and organize cells during the printing process, enabling improved structural and functional properties of engineered tissues. ARSL is looking for a highly motivated, creative, and collaborative intern with a strong experimental background in electrical and mechanical engineering, or a closely related field. Tasks • Design and fabrication of mechanical components for experimental setups using CAD tools • Development, optimization, and operation of 3D printing systems (e.g., DLP, SLA, FDM) • Assembly and testing of mechanical and mechatronic systems for bioprinting platforms • Support in prototyping, system integration, and experimental validation • Documentation of designs, workflows, and experimental results Anforderungen: • Background in Mechanical engineering, Electrical engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field • Experience with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360) • Hands-on experience with 3D printing (highly desirable) • Practical skills in prototyping and working with laboratory hardware (highly desirable) • Strong communication skills We offer • Creative and international environment to conduct competitive research in an interdisciplinary team • Strong links to the Bern University Hospital (Inselspital) to provide a coherent and holistic view of how engineering solutions can benefit patients • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge research projects in bioprinting, acoustics, and microrobotics • Expected start date: flexible (as soon as possible) • Free German courses available for those wishing to learn The University of Bern is an equal opportunity employer, promotes healthy work-life-balance and safe working environments, and strives to increase the number of women at all levels in its faculties. Wir bieten: International reputation

jobs.description:
UniBE is ambitious.
With us, you deliver top performance and test your skills against the best. Aufgaben: We are developing a robot-assisted, image-guided ultrasound platform for the minimally invasive and localized treatment of bladder tumours. The project combines medical robotics, real-time imaging, therapeutic ultrasound, and closed-loop control to achieve precise and reproducible targeting. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the University Clinic for Urology at Bern University Hospital. This collaboration provides direct access to clinical expertise, clinically relevant workflows, human tissue specimens, and preclinical validation facilities. The postdoctoral researcher will lead the development and integration of the robotic treatment platform. The work will include robotic positioning of ultrasound transducers, multimodal image guidance, system calibration, image-to-robot registration, treatment planning, trajectory generation, and closed-loop control. The platform will initially be validated using tissue-mimicking phantoms and ex vivo tissue, followed by evaluation in clinically relevant preclinical models. The researcher will work closely with engineers, ultrasound researchers, biomedical scientists, and clinical urologists. Anforderungen: We are looking for a highly motivated, creative, and collaborative researcher with a strong background in robotics, control, automation, mechatronics, or a closely related field. The candidate will have experience in several of the following areas: • robotic-arm programming and experimental system integration; • robot kinematics, calibration, and coordinate transformations; • image-guided control, visual servoing, or autonomous robotic scanning; • trajectory generation, motion planning, and closed-loop control; • ROS or ROS 2; • programming in Python, C++, or MATLAB/Simulink; • computer vision, image registration, segmentation, or target tracking; • integration of cameras, imaging systems, sensors, and actuators; • rapid prototyping, CAD, 3D printing, fixtures, and instrumentation; • experimental validation of robotic or medical systems. Experience in the following areas would be beneficial but is not required: • medical robotics or image-guided interventions; • robot-assisted ultrasound imaging; • therapeutic ultrasound or HIFU; • endoscopic imaging; • medical-device development; • experiments involving biological tissue or animal models; • machine learning for image segmentation or robotic control. Prior expertise in ultrasound is advantageous but not essential. Training and support in ultrasound physics, acoustic calibration, and therapeutic-ultrasound operation will be provided by the ARSL team. Requirements • PhD in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechatronics, Control Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field; • strong hands-on experience in developing and operating robotic experimental systems; • excellent programming and analytical skills; • ability to independently develop and troubleshoot integrated hardware–software platforms; • strong interest in medical robotics and translational technology development; • excellent written and spoken English; • motivation to work within an interdisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, and clinicians. The preferred starting date is asap, or by agreement. The position will be based at the ARTORG Center for Biomedical Engineering Research, University of Bern, with close collaboration with the University Clinic for Urology at Inselspital, Bern University Hospital. Wir bieten: Strong research infrastructure and international network

descriptionByLocale.it:
<b> UniBE è ambizioso. Con noi, si offre le migliori prestazioni e testare le vostre abilità contro il meglio.

Aufgaben:
Stiamo sviluppando una piattaforma ultrasuoni robot-assistita e guidata da immagini per il trattamento minimo invasivo e localizzato dei tumori della vescica. Il progetto combina robotica medica, imaging in tempo reale, ultrasuoni terapeutici e controllo a ciclo chiuso per raggiungere obiettivi precisi e riproducibili. Il progetto sarà condotto in stretta collaborazione con la Clinica Universitaria per Urologia presso l'Ospedale Universitario di Berna. Questa collaborazione fornisce accesso diretto alle competenze cliniche, ai flussi di lavoro clinicamente rilevanti, ai campioni di tessuto umano e alle strutture di validazione preclinica. Il ricercatore postdoctoral porterà lo sviluppo e l'integrazione della piattaforma di trattamento robotico. Il lavoro comprenderà il posizionamento robotico di trasduttori a ultrasuoni, la guida multimodale dell'immagine, la calibrazione del sistema, la registrazione dell'immagine-to-robot, la pianificazione del trattamento, la generazione della traiettoria e il controllo a ciclo chiuso. La piattaforma sarà inizialmente validata utilizzando phantoms e tessuto ex vivo, seguito dalla valutazione in modelli preclinici clinicamente rilevanti. Il ricercatore lavorerà a stretto contatto con ingegneri, ricercatori ecografici, scienziati biomedici e urologi clinici.

Anforderungen:
Stiamo cercando un ricercatore altamente motivato, creativo e collaborativo con un forte background in robotica, controllo, automazione, meccatronica, o un campo strettamente correlato.
Il candidato avrà esperienza in diverse delle seguenti aree:
• programmazione robot-arm e integrazione del sistema sperimentale;

• robot cinematica, calibrazione e trasformazioni coordinate;

• controllo dell'immagine, servostazione visiva o scansione robotica autonoma;

• generazione della traiettoria, pianificazione del movimento e controllo a ciclo chiuso;

• ROS o ROS 2;

• programmazione in Python, C++ o MATLAB/Simulink;

• visione del computer, registrazione dell'immagine, segmentazione o monitoraggio del bersaglio;

• integrazione di telecamere, sistemi di imaging, sensori e attuatori;

• prototipazione rapida, CAD, stampa 3D, apparecchi e strumentazione;

• convalida sperimentale di sistemi robotizzati o medici.

L'esperienza nelle seguenti aree sarebbe utile ma non è richiesta:
• robotica medica o interventi orientati alle immagini;

• imaging ad ultrasuoni assistito da robot;

• ultrasuoni terapeutici o HIFU;

• imaging endoscopico;

• sviluppo medico-dispositivo;

• esperimenti che coinvolgono tessuti biologici o modelli animali;

• machine learning per la segmentazione delle immagini o il controllo robotico.
Le competenze precedenti nell'ecografia sono vantaggiose ma non essenziali. La formazione e il supporto nella fisica degli ultrasuoni, nella calibrazione acustica e nell'operazione terapeutica-ultrasound saranno forniti dal team ARSL.

Requisiti
• Dottorato in Robotica, Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Biomedicale, Meccatronica, Ingegneria di Controllo, Scienza Informatica, o un campo strettamente correlato;

• forte esperienza pratica nello sviluppo e nella gestione di sistemi sperimentali robotici;

• eccellente programmazione e abilità analitiche;

• capacità di sviluppare e risolvere in modo indipendente piattaforme hardware-software integrate;

• forte interesse per la robotica medica e lo sviluppo tecnologico traduttivo;

• eccellente scritto e parlato inglese;

• motivazione a lavorare all'interno di un team interdisciplinare di ingegneri, scienziati e clinici.

La data di partenza preferita è asap, o per accordo. La posizione si baserà presso l'ARTORG Center for Biomedical Engineering Research dell'Università di Berna, con una stretta collaborazione con la Clinica Universitaria per l'Urologia dell'Inselspital dell'Università di Berna.

Wir bieten:
Forte infrastruttura di ricerca e rete internazionale

UniBE ist ehrgeizig.
Bei uns liefern Sie Spitzenleistungen und testen Ihre Fähigkeiten gegen die Besten. Aufgaben: Wir entwickeln eine robotergestützte, bildgeführte Ultraschallplattform für die minimalinvasive und lokalisierte Behandlung von Blasentumoren. Das Projekt kombiniert medizinische Robotik, Echtzeit-Bildgebung, therapeutischen Ultraschall und Closed-Loop-Kontrolle, um ein präzises und reproduzierbares Targeting zu erreichen. Das Projekt wird in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Universitätsklinik für Urologie am Universitätsklinikum Bern durchgeführt. Diese Zusammenarbeit bietet direkten Zugang zu klinischem Fachwissen, klinisch relevanten Workflows, menschlichen Gewebeproben und präklinischen Validierungseinrichtungen. Der Postdoktorand wird die Entwicklung und Integration der Roboter-Behandlungsplattform leiten. Die Arbeit umfasst die Roboterpositionierung von Ultraschallwandlern, multimodale Bildführung, Systemkalibrierung, Bild-zu-Roboter-Registrierung, Behandlungsplanung, Flugbahnerzeugung und Steuerung. Die Plattform wird zunächst mit gewebeähnlichen Phantomen und Ex-vivo-Gewebe validiert, gefolgt von einer Bewertung in klinisch relevanten präklinischen Modellen. Der Forscher wird eng mit Ingenieuren, Ultraschallforschern, biomedizinischen Wissenschaftlern und klinischen Urologen zusammenarbeiten. Anforderungen: Wir suchen einen hoch motivierten, kreativen und kooperativen Forscher mit einem starken Hintergrund in Robotik, Steuerung, Automatisierung, Mechatronik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich. Der Kandidat wird Erfahrung in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche haben: • Roboter-Arm-Programmierung und experimentelle Systemintegration; • Roboterkinematik, Kalibrierung und Koordinatentransformationen; • bildgeführte Steuerung, visuelle Wartung oder autonomes Roboter-Scannen; • Flugbahnerzeugung, Bewegungsplanung und Regelung; • ROS oder ROS 2; • Programmierung in Python, C++ oder MATLAB/Simulink; • Computer Vision, Bildregistrierung, Segmentierung oder Zielverfolgung; • Integration von Kameras, bildgebenden Systemen, Sensoren und Aktoren; • Rapid Prototyping, CAD, 3D-Druck, Armaturen und Instrumentierung; • experimentelle Validierung von Roboter- oder medizinischen Systemen. Erfahrung in den folgenden Bereichen wäre von Vorteil, ist aber nicht erforderlich: • medizinische Robotik oder bildgeführte Eingriffe; • robotergestützte Ultraschallbildgebung; • therapeutischer Ultraschall oder HIFU; • endoskopische Bildgebung; • Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten; • Versuche mit biologischen Gewebe- oder Tiermodellen; • maschinelles Lernen zur Bildsegmentierung oder Robotersteuerung. Vorkenntnisse im Ultraschall sind vorteilhaft, aber nicht unerlässlich. Das ARSL-Team wird Schulungen und Unterstützung in der Ultraschallphysik, der akustischen Kalibrierung und dem therapeutischen Ultraschallbetrieb anbieten. Anforderungen • PhD in Robotik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Biomedizinische Technik, Mechatronik, Steuerungstechnik, Informatik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich; • starke praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb von experimentellen Robotersystemen; • ausgezeichnete Programmier- und Analysefähigkeiten; • Fähigkeit, integrierte Hardware-Software-Plattformen unabhängig zu entwickeln und zu beheben; • starkes Interesse an medizinischer Robotik und translationaler Technologieentwicklung; • ausgezeichnetes geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch; • Motivation, in einem interdisziplinären Team von Ingenieuren, Wissenschaftlern und Klinikern zu arbeiten. Der bevorzugte Starttermin ist asap oder nach Vereinbarung. Die Position wird am ARTORG Center for Biomedical Engineering Research, Universität Bern, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Universitätsklinik für Urologie am Inselspital, Universitätsklinikum Bern, angesiedelt sein. Cette collaboration permet un accès direct à l'expertise clinique, aux flux de travail cliniquement pertinents, aux échantillons de tissus humains et aux installations de validation préclinique. Le chercheur postdoctoral dirigera le développement et l'intégration de la plateforme de traitement robotique. Le travail comprendra le positionnement robotique des transducteurs à ultrasons, le guidage d'images multimodales, l'étalonnage du système, l'enregistrement image-robot, la planification du traitement, la génération de trajectoires et le contrôle en boucle fermée. La plateforme sera initialement validée à l'aide de fantômes et de tissus ex vivo, suivis d'une évaluation dans des modèles précliniques cliniquement pertinents. Le chercheur travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs, des chercheurs en échographie, des scientifiques biomédicaux et des urologues cliniques. - C'est pas vrai. Nous recherchons un chercheur hautement motivé, créatif et collaboratif ayant une solide expérience en robotique, contrôle, automatisation, mécatronique, ou un domaine étroitement lié. Le candidat aura de l'expérience dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : • la programmation d'armes robotiques et l'intégration de systèmes expérimentaux; • la cinématique des robots, l'étalonnage et les transformations coordonnées; • contrôle guidé par l'image, servage visuel ou balayage robotique autonome; • la génération de trajectoires, la planification des mouvements et le contrôle en boucle fermée; • ROS ou ROS 2; • programmation en Python, C++ ou MATLAB/Simulink; • vision de l'ordinateur, enregistrement d'image, segmentation ou suivi de la cible; • l'intégration des caméras, systèmes d'imagerie, capteurs et actionneurs; • le prototypage rapide, l'impression en CAO, en 3D, les luminaires et les instruments; • validation expérimentale des systèmes robotiques ou médicaux. L'expérience dans les domaines suivants serait bénéfique mais n'est pas requise : • la robotique médicale ou les interventions guidées par l'image; • l'imagerie par échographie assistée par robot; • échographie thérapeutique ou HIFU; • l'imagerie endoscopique; • développement des dispositifs médicaux; • les expériences impliquant des modèles biologiques de tissus ou d'animaux; • apprentissage automatique pour la segmentation de l'image ou le contrôle robotique. Une expertise préalable en échographie est avantageuse mais pas essentielle. L'équipe de l'ARSL assurera la formation et le soutien en physique des ultrasons, en calibration acoustique et en opérations d'ultrasons thérapeutiques. Exigences • Doctorat en robotique, génie mécanique, génie électrique, génie biomédical, mécatronique, génie du contrôle, informatique ou domaine étroitement lié; • une solide expérience pratique dans le développement et l'exploitation de systèmes expérimentaux robotiques; • excellentes compétences en programmation et en analyse; • la capacité de développer et de dépanner de manière indépendante des plateformes matérielles et logicielles intégrées; • un vif intérêt pour la robotique médicale et le développement des technologies de traduction; • excellent anglais écrit et parlé; • motivation à travailler au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire d'ingénieurs, de scientifiques et de cliniciens. La date de départ préférée est asap, ou par accord. Le poste sera situé au Centre ARTORG de recherche en génie biomédical de l'Université de Berne, avec une collaboration étroite avec la Clinique Universitaire d'Urologie de l'Hôpital Universitaire de Berne. - Oui. Forte infrastructure de recherche et réseau international
